cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Try It First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to test the shortcut, substitute, or questionable fix before you rely on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Turn the kitchen tap on before I start washing up. I've tightened the loose joint.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Wear my apron. I need to know whether the joint holds.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You wear it and turn the tap.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll need it dry for washing up. You can have my raincoat for the test.

mechanism: A uses qualified repair-testing procedure to make B take the splash risk before A relies on the questionable tap fix.
confusable: Ordinary responsible testing can be done by the fixer; D32 requires A to make someone else test before A uses it.
comparison: Coffee alternative negotiates taste testing of a substitute; tap alternative divides observer and operator roles to keep A dry.
seedUse: Tightened tap joint and prior spray derive from D32-a; S03 adds controlled opening and observation roles as the expert reason B must test.
